title: Sara won’t campaign for any senatorial bet
summary: Vice President Sara Duterte said she won’t be campaigning for any senatorial aspirant in 2028. “I will not campaign for senators. I am already tired of campaigning for senators in 2019…

blocks.text: Vice President Sara Duterte said her camp is forming an information technology team and a legal team to prepare for possible cheating in the 2028 elections, should she decide to run, during a press conference at the Office of the Vice President in Mandaluyong City on November 27, 2026

MANILA, Philippines — Vice President Sara Duterte said she won’t be campaigning for any senatorial aspirant in 2028. “I will not campaign for senators. I am already tired of campaigning for senators in 2019 and 2022,” she said at a press briefing.

“I was forced to say names of people I did not even like. I was forced to campaign for people I do not believe in. So, no, no, no, I will not campaign for senators if I run for president,” Duterte added.
But if she would be able to run for president in the next elections, Duterte said she would want a running mate she could fully trust.

“For me, it would be useful to have a running mate, especially a running mate that you could trust. So first, he or she would not have me impeached; second, he or she would not have me killed; and third, he or she would not poison me,” Duterte said.
The Vice President would be removed from her position and perpetually banned from holding public office if she gets convicted in her impeachment trial.
